The main takeaway from our work is that

we have shown that it is possible to train a group of elite junior speed skaters to increase their isokinetic strength and to improve their body composition in a manner that is consistent with the changes seen in the age-matched controls.
the use of a high intensity, short duration training protocol can improve the performance of elite junior speed skaters.
